# Dsoar Thick Side Bangs Clip-In Real Human Hair Fringe

Refresh your look in minutes with these side-swept bangs. Made from 100% real human hair, they give you a fuller, polished style without a salon visit or a trim.

## Natural Blend With Your Hair

Each piece is crafted from straight, soft real human hair and comes in six shades, including Blonde/613#, Jet Black, Natural Black, Dark Brown, and Light Brown. The fringe is designed to blend with your own hair, so you can change your style while keeping a natural finish.

## Effortless Clip-In Wear

Two invisible clips secure the bangs quickly, and each piece weighs about 16g, so they feel comfortable for daily wear or a night out. Clip them in before work or a party, then remove them just as fast.

## Styling Flexibility

Trim, curl, or straighten the bangs to match your look. Use them as a hairpiece to add volume to your overall style, or use the included splint to shape them. Style them with the heat tools you already own.

## Simple Care

Gently wash the bangs in warm water with a mild, moisturizing shampoo, rinse, blot with a towel, and let them air dry. Regular care keeps the hair soft and helps it look fresh over time.

## Ready to Transform Your Style?

Add the Dsoar Side Bangs to your cart for $21.99 and discover a new look without cutting your own hair.
